capabilities: Register tasks with subtasks, checklists, stage goals and files
Plan weeks on a yearly week axis with day cards and daily goals
Color hours in a time box view
Compare planned and actual time per category
Capture ideas in an inbox and turn them into tasks
disambiguation: Not a simple to-do list; it plans weeks with time blocks and tracks planned versus actual time.
extras: All records are stored locally in the vault and can be exported to Excel/CSV; the plugin includes built-in themes, a card-based layout editor and an in-app help panel.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to lay out a week of tasks on particular days and hours and then review how that plan actually went.
summary: Weekly schedule planner that places tasks on specific days and hours, tracks execution time, and compares planned with actual time.
